info.title: Aletheia K04 hosted producer extension
info.description: Additive maintained producer schemas and synthetic wire examples; runtime qualification is recorded separately and no joint acceptance is implied. Server revalidates current session, membership, scope and grants on every request. Mutation authority never comes from browser role or user fields.
